title: The Hypertext Transfer Protocol Status Code 483 (I'm Not a Freezer)
llm_summary: The draft “HTTP 483 I’m Not a Freezer” is a tongue‑in‑cheek proposal for a new HTTP status code that tells a client, “I’m not going to keep your request on ice forever.” It’s meant as a humorous way to signal that a server will not hold a request pending indefinitely
